literal.prompt: Какой договор 1689 года стал первым соглашением России с Китаем?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained official Presidential Library page identifies the Nerchinsk Treaty as the first Russia–China treaty and dates it 1689 (turn1view1 L40-L45). It also identifies the 1618 Deulino truce with Poland (turn1view0 L44-L47), while the retained official Crimea page says the Paris peace ended that war (turn3view3 L51), and the U.S. Department of State treaty text gives Brest Litovsk, 3 March 1918 and cessation of war between Russia and the Central Powers (turn3view0 L14-L18, L82). Thus only Nerchinsk matches both 1689 and Russia–China.
literalGroups.locator: Nerchinsk turn1view1 L40-L45; Deulino turn1view0 L44-L47; Paris turn3view3 L51; Brest turn3view0 L14-L18,L82

literalGroups.literal: Нерчинский договор 1689 года стал первым договором России с Китаем. Он определил условия отношений двух государств и наметил границу в Приамурье лишь в общих чертах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official library page calls the 1689 Nerchinsk agreement the first Russia–China treaty (turn1view1 L40-L45), describes mutual trade and the border arrangements (L50), and explicitly qualifies the boundary as only sketched in general terms and unclear in places (L51-L52). The revised sentence preserves that qualification.

literalGroups.literal: Деулинское перемирие 1618 года приостановило боевые действия России с Речью Посполитой на 14,5 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Deulino article says the Russian and Polish delegations concluded a truce for 14.5 years on 1 (11) December 1618 (turn1view0 L44-L47); it supports a truce that halted hostilities for that term, not an unconditional end to the Russo-Polish war.

literalGroups.literal: Договором разрешалась взаимная торговля между подданными России и Цинской империи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Nerchinsk page states that the treaty permitted mutual trade between subjects of Russia and the Qing Empire (turn1view1 L50). This is a concrete fact about the correct option beyond the prompt and key.

literalGroups.literal: Парижский мирный договор 1856 года завершил Крымскую войну.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Presidential Library page states that the Crimean War ended with the Paris peace treaty signed 18 (30) March 1856 (turn3view3 L51).

literalGroups.literal: Статья 1 Брест-Литовского договора прекратила состояние войны между Россией и державами Центрального блока; договор подписали 3 марта 1918 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Article 1 of the retained treaty says Russia and Germany, Austria-Hungary, Bulgaria, and Turkey declared the state of war between them ceased (turn3view0 L14-L18); the execution line dates the treaty 3 March 1918 (L80-L82).
